title: AIR Deterministic Policy Pack
purpose: Optionally evaluate crisp AIR invariants deterministically, including Q2 strictness routing and user-controlled local OPA execution, while preserving contextual AIR judgment, AIR_GATE precedence, offline prompt operation, privacy minimization and visible mode/evidence boundaries.

PROMPT_SIMULATED.description: The host model evaluates the canonical rule contract and must disclose that no external executable enforced the result.

TOOL_EVALUATED.description: An optional user-controlled local policy engine evaluates the equivalent policy through CLI or loopback-only server mode and returns engine, policy, input, result, error and provenance evidence.

canonical_input_contract.rule: Unknown, malformed, contradictory, stale, or materially incomplete input may not default to ALLOW.

compatibility_defaults.legacy_tool_endpoint: LOCAL_CLI when direct invocation is evidenced

decision_contract.runtime_conflict_rule: The stricter valid AIR Core Runtime, active contract, AIR_GATE or scoped user-approval result governs.

rule_families.invariant: Malformed, contradictory, or materially incomplete policy input cannot produce ALLOW.
Material mutation requires scoped approval when approval_required is true.
Reusable binding requires validation PASS plus explicit binding approval.
Repository and release actions require their own explicit approval.
An artifact or policy result cannot approve or bind itself.
OPA, hosted services, plugins, package managers, network access, or proprietary engines may not become mandatory baseline dependencies.
Raw human taxonomy requirements may not bind directly without the approved Human-to-Machine Translator.
Human licensure, authority, credentials, protected status, embodiment, employment, organizational status, and legal standing do not transfer to AIR.
Backend, cryptographic, repository, release, compliance, professional-equivalence, or empirical claims require matching evidence state.
PROMPT_SIMULATED and TOOL_EVALUATED remain distinct; silent mode upgrade is prohibited.
Engine absence, parse/compile/evaluation error, undefined result, stale version, or missing provenance must fail closed or visibly downgrade.
When an active contract explicitly requires TOOL_EVALUATED, unavailable or unauthorized local tooling cannot silently downgrade to ALLOW.
The WS5.1 baseline permits direct local CLI or loopback-only server endpoints; non-loopback endpoints require a separately approved remote-service architecture.
AIR may not require an author-operated or central policy service as the public baseline.
A Policy Pack result cannot override a stricter Runtime, active-contract, AIR_GATE, or user-approval result.

prompt_simulated_procedure: Reject or route missing, malformed, contradictory, stale, or unknown material fields.
Evaluate every applicable rule; collect all matched rule ids and evidence requirements.
Select the strictest decision by ERROR > REJECT > EVIDENCE_REQUIRED > REVIEW > ALLOW.
Compare the result with Runtime, active contract, AIR_GATE and scoped approval; apply the stricter valid result.
Emit the canonical decision object and disclose PROMPT_SIMULATED mode and claim ceiling.

optional_tool_adapter_contract.preferred_compatibility: OPA/Rego v1-compatible or equivalent declarative policy engine
optional_tool_adapter_contract.fallback: PROMPT_SIMULATED with visible degraded evidence state when permitted; otherwise EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or stricter Runtime result.

claim_boundary: This Policy Pack provides prompt-compiled/file-backed deterministic governance and an optional tool-adapter contract. It does not prove backend AIR enforcement, legal compliance, professional equivalence, empirical improvement, cryptographic integrity, repository alignment, publication, or release readiness.

state_model.separation_rule: Posture controls check frequency; mode records evaluator/evidence.

local_data_boundary.ai_host_boundary: Conversation content and files deliberately sent to an AI host remain subject to that host; local OPA does not make the AI session local.
